item.title: Vaidehi Chaudhari wins women's singles title at W35 Solapur 2025 Tennis Tournament
item.description: Meanwhile, Ankita Raina and Vaishnavi Adkar clinched the women's doubles title.

item.title: Badminton Nationals: Surya Charishma Tamiri and Rithvik Sanjeevi claim singles titles
item.description: Local favourite Surya Charishma staged a comeback in the women’s final, while Rithvik Sanjeevi sealed the men’s crown in Vijayawada.

item.title: Commonwealth to Asian Games: Major sporting events to watch out for in 2026
item.description: 2026 will be an action-packed year for Indian sports, featuring a couple of multi-sport events and Olympic qualifiers.

item.title: India pile up record 221 to overpower Sri Lanka, seal 4–0 lead in T20I series
item.description: Mandhana and Shafali smash record opening stand as India overwhelm Sri Lanka by 30 runs in Thiruvananthapuram.

item.title: Explained: Why Koneru Humpy had to settle for bronze at World Rapid Championships
item.description: Tie-break rules, not points, denied Koneru Humpy a historic third World Rapid title in Doha.

item.title: SG Pipers open Women’s Hero Hockey India League with 2–0 win over Ranchi Royals
item.description: Captain Navneet Kaur leads from the front as SG Pipers secure a composed victory in the opening match of the new season.

item.title: 2025: The year Indian women athletes conquered the global sporting arenas
item.description: Spanning elite podiums and overlooked sports, 2025 emerged as a defining year for women athletes in reshaping the country’s sporting landscape.

item.title: Shrachi Bengal Tigers edge JSW Soorma Hockey Club 1-0 in Women’s Hero HIL
item.description: Agustina Gorzelany’s early drag-flick proves decisive as Shrachi Bengal Tigers hold firm against sustained pressure in Ranchi.

item.title: World Blitz C'ship: Arjun Erigaisi stuns Magnus Carlsen; joint leader after 13 rounds
item.description: Arjun won 10 points from 13 games and now shares the top spot with Fabiano Caruana and Maxime Vachier-Lagrave.

item.title: WPL 2026: Australian all-rounder Ashleigh Gardner to continue as captain of Gujarat Giants
item.description: Gardner led the Giants for their first-ever top-3 finish in the last edition of WPL.
